sloka: साधु किम् ते अन्यया बुद्ध्या रोचयस्व वचो मम ।भजस्व मा अभितप्तस्य प्रसादम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि ॥३-५५-१८॥
transliteration: sādhu kim te anyayā buddhyā rocayasva vaco mama ।bhajasva mā abhitaptasya prasādam kartum arhasi ॥3-55-18॥

translations.english: Do not think otherwise. Be good and accept my request. I am consumed by thoughts of you. You should be gracious to me.
